notes: Adding a song to an album now lists the albums you already have, with how many songs each one holds, instead of asking you to type a name and making a second album behind your back.
A long list of albums no longer runs off the top of the screen: the sheet stops at the height of the glass and the rows scroll inside it, so the choice that makes a new album is always reachable.
An album with no songs is not drawn as an album any more, and a name on a tile wraps onto a second line instead of being cut off - so the page shows albums that exist.
